name: Vanguardism
summary: Vanguardism holds that the working class, left to itself, develops only trade-union consciousness, and that a disciplined party of committed, mostly professional revolutionaries must lead it to overthrow capitalism and establish proletarian rule. It is the Leninist theory of the party, developed from Kautsky's idea in What Is to Be Done? and later tied to democratic centralism and the party's leading role in communist states.
scope: The Leninist vanguard-party theory as set out in Lenin's What Is to Be Done? (1902) and its later development into democratic centralism and the party's leading role in communist states. It does not cover other Leninist doctrines in detail (see leninism and marxism-leninism); answers beyond party organisation are mostly inferred and low confidence.

unions-good.rationale: Lenin wanted broad, open trade unions as workers' organisations but held that trade unionism alone means ideological subordination to the bourgeoisie, so the answer is a qualified yes.

gradual-change.rationale: Lenin attacked 'slavish cringing before spontaneity' and trade-unionist reformism, wanting the party to divert the movement toward revolution.

revolution-justified.rationale: The vanguard party exists to lead the proletariat in overthrowing capitalism, and Lenin condemned reliance on spontaneous or trade-union struggle alone.

one-party-rule.rationale: Vanguardism holds that the party leads the proletariat and, in practice, communist states formalised the party's leading role and single-party rule after 1921.

class-struggle-history.rationale: The vanguard's task presupposes the Marxist view that class struggle drives history and that the proletariat must be led to a political class struggle.

direct-action.rationale: The vanguard favours organised party-led political struggle over spontaneous action, but also revolution outside elections; adherents are split.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: The vanguard is meant to lead the political struggle that establishes the dictatorship of the proletariat on the way to communism.

vanguard-party.rationale: Lenin argued that workers by their own effort develop only trade-union consciousness, so socialist consciousness must be brought by a disciplined organisation of professional revolutionaries; this is the defining claim of vanguardism.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Democratic centralism, the vanguard party's organising rule, binds members to carry out adopted decisions after free discussion.

clerical-rule.rationale: The vanguard party claims the highest political authority for itself, within a Marxist rejection of religious power.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Lenin argued in 1914-15 that socialists should work for their own government's defeat in an imperialist war. That is a Leninist corollary, not part of the vanguard concept, and What Is to Be Done? does not state it.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Vanguardism concerns party organisation; Leninist internationalism points against national alliances, but communist states did form them, so adherents are split.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Lenin holds that socialist consciousness is brought to workers by educated revolutionaries from outside, so the educated are not seen as out of touch.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Vanguardism does not address this; adherents are indifferent or split.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Vanguardism does not address this; adherents are indifferent or split.

collective-defense.rationale: Vanguardism does not address alliances; Leninists have signed pacts both ways.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: Lenin backed national self-determination in principle but the party-state used force to keep territory in practice; adherents are split.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-12): its rationale rests on general self-government, separate laws or no stated position, not on keeping a distinct economic system, and the statement now asks only whether a region joining a larger state should be free to keep its economic system.

reviewHistory.rationale: Lenin accepted autonomy within a unified party-led state, but democratic centralism stresses uniformity; adherents are split.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: Marxist historical materialism is the background, though the vanguard thesis itself stresses consciousness brought from outside the economic struggle.

delink-world-market.rationale: Leninist states pursued socialist construction behind state control of trade, but delinking is a Third-Worldist doctrine; adherents are split.

minority-veto.rationale: Democratic centralism binds the minority to the majority decision.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Professional revolutionaries devote their whole lives to the party, and Lenin stresses organization over spontaneity.

recallable-delegates.rationale: Nulled (statement review, 2026-11-11): its value turns on whether representatives must follow binding instructions, and the statement now asks only whether voters can recall them at any time.

reviewHistory.rationale: Democratic centralism has lower bodies elect higher ones and bind them to decisions, but binds members upward, so adherents split.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Revolutionaries owe no duty to bourgeois law, yet the party demands strict obedience to its own decisions; adherents split by whose law is meant.

industrial-unions.rationale: Soviet-model unions were organised by industry under party guidance; Lenin also saw plain trade unionism as insufficient.

informal-organisation.rationale: Lenin argues that loose amateur circles must give way to a permanent, centralised organisation of professional revolutionaries.

suppress-opposition.rationale: Democratic centralism bans factions and binds members to party decisions, and Lenin's party sought a leading role excluding rival parties.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Leninist vanguardism sits within anti-imperialism; colonial exploitation is rejected.

participatory-democracy.rationale: Vanguardism holds that the working class alone develops only trade-union consciousness and needs leadership; direct participation is subordinate to the party.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Leninism rests on class struggle; the division is real and not to be blended.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Leninism is atheist and holds authority to rest with the proletarian party.

property-franchise.rationale: Vanguardism seeks proletarian rule and sees bourgeois franchise rules as class domination; it does not favour wealth-based voting.

reification.rationale: The Marxist setting holds that capitalism makes social relations appear as relations of things (commodity fetishism), though What Is to Be Done? does not use the term.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Marxist-Leninist thought holds bourgeois liberties are formal while capital owns the press; Lenin made the point explicitly.

racial-franchise.rationale: Marxist-Leninists oppose racial distinctions and hold that class, not race, defines political rights.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: Democratic centralism and the party's leading role mean power is held by the party rather than shared among communities.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: Leninist socialism holds that those who do not work should not eat and that the product goes to the worker, not to owners of capital.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: The vanguard is a party of professional revolutionaries preparing the overthrow of capitalism by force; pacifism of this kind is foreign to it.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Leninist theory is materialist and class-based and does not frame politics as a spiritual struggle.

culture-before-state.rationale: Lenin's argument is that the party must first seize political power and then transform society, so cultural renewal before the state reverses his order.

independent-unions.rationale: Lenin gives trade unions only trade-union consciousness and democratic centralism places the party in the leading role over mass organisations, so independence from the party is not part of it.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: Vanguardism aims at rule by the proletariat through its party, so it holds that working-class power is the test of socialism, though it exercises that power through the party.

confederal-coordination.rationale: Democratic centralism makes decisions binding upward and forbids factions, and Lenin calls for centralised organisation, so delegates only coordinating would be rejected.

family-wage.rationale: Vanguardism does not address wages or family structure; adherents are split or indifferent.

online-anonymity.rationale: Lenin values secrecy for the underground party but vanguard states control communication; adherents split.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Vanguardism concerns party organisation and takes no stand on when armed force is used; adherents are split.

open-diplomacy.rationale: Lenin's 1917 decree denounced secret treaties, but Leninist states later practised secret diplomacy, and the vanguard theory itself is silent; adherents are split.

workers-own-party.rationale: The vanguard theory calls for the working class to have its own disciplined party of revolutionaries, separate from other parties.

one-language-many-names.rationale: Vanguardism does not address regional language naming; Soviet practice varied.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: The theory addresses party organisation, not environment versus liberty; adherents are split.

mandatory-sentences.rationale: The theory addresses party organisation, not sentencing; adherents are split.

voter-id.rationale: The theory concerns party leadership, not electoral administration; adherents have no settled view.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Vanguardism holds the party leads in the working class's interest, so electoral procedure alone does not make a government democratic.

restrict-indigenous-settlement.rationale: The theory is silent on settlement in Indigenous regions and Leninist states differed in practice; no basis for a stronger answer.

bypass-parties-groups.rationale: The vanguard theory makes the disciplined party the necessary leader of the masses, and the party's leading role is central (s3, s4).

labour-theory-of-value.rationale: Vanguardism rests on Marxism, whose economics holds that labour creates value, though the vanguard sources discuss party organisation rather than value theory.

missingStatements.text: Members of a political party should be bound to carry out its decisions once they have been debated and adopted.
missingStatements.rationale: Democratic centralism, the vanguard party's organising rule, pairs free discussion with strict unity of action after a decision.

notes: Answers other than party organisation largely follow the Leninist profile and are low confidence; the Kautskyist and later Maoist or Third World vanguardisms are not separately distinguished.
